limits.selection_rule: Rows floor((N-1)*q)+1, q=0.25,0.5,0.75, from each original scenario file, before execution
limits.solver: scipy.sparse.csgraph.dijkstra, weighted 8-connected grid without corner cutting

provenance.attribution: Moving AI Lab, Nathan Sturtevant; city/street maps provided by Konstantin Yakovlev and Anton Andreychuk
provenance.citation: N. Sturtevant, Benchmarks for Grid-Based Pathfinding, IEEE TCIAIG 4(2), 144-148, 2012
